items.item_text: 01. When answering these supplemental questions, your response must be based on your direct professional experience. Clearly identify your role/title and the organization where the example occurred. Specific details (e.g., scope, outcomes, or data) are desired. Responses that are overly general or do not demonstrate direct experience may not be advanced. Options: Yes | No

02. Describe your experience managing or overseeing payroll operations, preferably in a public agency, government, or higher education environment. Include the complexity of payrolls you have managed, the number of employees served, your responsibilities, and your experience ensuring compliance with applicable payroll laws, regulations, and policies.

03. Describe your experience overseeing payroll processing to ensure the accuracy of employee compensation, attendance, hours worked, overtime, leave balances, deductions, and adjustments. What procedures and internal controls have you implemented to minimize errors and ensure employees are paid accurately and timely?

04. Describe your experience supervising and managing payroll personnel. How do you assign workloads, establish performance expectations, train employees, and ensure accountability? Please provide an example of how you addressed a performance issue or improved the effectiveness of your team.

05. Describe your experience working with an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, such as Ellucian Banner, PeopleSoft, or other payroll systems. Include your experience with system configuration, payroll processing, system interfaces, troubleshooting, testing, and implementing system improvements. How have you addressed system limitations or integration issues that affected payroll operations?

06. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses are required as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No
